delivery.method: Local verified ZIP and extracted folder; small report, manifest, checksums and guide attachments on board.

guideClosure: 32 allowlisted payloads include recursive local guide/reference set, complete generated schemas, LICENSE, qualified reports and source/evidence boundary note. Source/tools/private qualification outputs are not implied runtime inputs.
qualificationReuse: Exact unchanged application; prior owner-accepted full suites/faults/compatibility are labeled reuse, not fresh kit execution.

independentReview.scope: Fresh non-author Sol / High kit/source/guide/evidence/packet assessment and independent fresh extraction/checksum/schema/help probes; audited normal demo is not a second full product execution.

limits: Synthetic Windows amd64/local NTFS/localhost only; no installer/general release, real-data adoption, expanded M05 links, physical power loss, full OS IME or whole-product accessibility.
Fresh normal extracted-kit demonstration and independent kit probes are separate from qualified reused full native/browser/clean-build/fault evidence.
ZIP exceeds10MiB channel: use local artifact; runtime/private data excluded; checksums are not signatures.
initialFailure: First normal harness expected explicit ownerId:null although accepted Card.OwnerID omits nil. Read-only source diagnosis confirmed omission encoding; fresh corrected second workspace passed with parent/priority/lane/approval checks unchanged.
